description: Five diverse merge inputs: empty existing + new topics (seed case), existing + non-overlapping new (pure additions), existing + alias-match new (alias-merge case), existing + completely-overlapping new (idempotency), and adjacent-but-distinct topic temptation (should NOT merge).

cases.name: empty_existing_seed

input.new_topics: [{"name":"Photosynthesis","description":"Process by which plants convert light into chemical energy.","complexity_level":2,"page_refs":[1,3]},{"name":"Cellular Respiration","description":"Process by which cells break down glucose to release energy.","complexity_level":3,"page_refs":[4,5]}]

expected_constraints: all new topics added with id='NEW'
mapping has exactly one entry per new topic

cases.name: non_overlapping_additions
expected_constraints: mapping has exactly one entry (for Mitosis)

cases.name: alias_match_merge

input.new_topics: [{"name":"Plant Photosynthesis","description":"The process by which plants synthesize glucose from sunlight, water, and CO2.","complexity_level":3,"page_refs":[10,12]}]

expected_constraints: 'Plant Photosynthesis' merges into tpc_001 (not a new topic)
complexity_level updated to rounded average (2+3=5, /2=2.5 → 3 or 2)

cases.name: idempotent_no_change
expected_constraints: no duplicate alias added (since 'Photosynthesis' is the canonical name)

cases.name: adjacent_but_distinct_no_merge

input.new_topics: [{"name":"Cellular Respiration","description":"How cells break down glucose to release energy.","complexity_level":3,"page_refs":[1]}]

expected_constraints: Cellular Respiration added as NEW — NOT merged with Photosynthesis
even though both involve cellular energy, descriptions are different processes
